column2: Retain Josiah's Passover to his God, plural sacrificers and day fourteen of month one. Jerusalem is not added as an explicit location within this verse.
Retain priests at their watches and strengthening for temple works. The king's support does not replace their assigned duties.

Retain mighty Levites, consecration, their actual placement of the ark in Solomon's house and the king's separate speech about no shoulder burden. Do not replace the narrative placement with an imperative to put the ark there.
Retain preparation by ancestral houses and courses, David's writing and Solomon's hand. The two authorities remain distinct in wording.
Retain standing in the house, family divisions, brethren identified as the people's sons and the Levites' ancestral-house portion. Do not invent a precise staffing ratio for each lay family.
column3: The final portion clause and its attachment remain provisional administrative syntax.

column2: Retain Passover slaughter and preparation of holy things for brethren under the Lord's word through Moses. The selected holy things is not converted into an additional self-sanctification command.
Retain sheep, lambs and goat offspring, 30,000 for everyone present and 3,000 calves, all from royal property. The 30,000 is the combined small-stock total, not a separate number for each category.
Retain rulers' contributions and Hilkiah/Zacharias/Jiiel as temple rulers giving 2,600 small stock and 300 calves to priests. Both general and specified donations remain.
Retain seven named Levitical leaders including Banaias and Jiiel, singular brother relation beside Nathanael, 5,000 sheep and 500 calves. Do not shorten the roster to match another version.
column3: The antecedent of his brother is contextually the preceding Samaias but remains a genealogy question.

column2: Retain ministry set right, priests' stations and Levites' divisions according to the king. The two assigned groups remain distinct.
Retain Passover slaughter, priests' blood pouring from their hands and Levites' skinning. Animals supplies the contextual object of skinning.
column3: The possessive in from their hands may refer to the slaughtering Levites rather than priests; the inherited wording leaves it open.

column2: Retain prepared burnt offering, family distribution to the people's sons, the Book of Moses and so until morning. Do not replace morning with calves from a different reading.
column3: The final temporal phrase and distinction between preparation and distribution require ritual/syntax review.

column2: Retain roasting the Passover in fire, boiling holy things in bronze vessels/cauldrons, success and running to the people. Do not convert the selected success clause into a third cookware category.
column3: The subject of went well and the implied purpose of running remain open.

column2: Retain the opening after-preparing phrase, priests occupied with fat and offerings until night and repeated Levite preparation for themselves and Aaron's sons. The apparent repeated preparation is not deleted.
column3: The opening pronoun and temporal construction remain a provisional close rendering.

column2: Retain Asaph's singers, David/Asaph/Heman/Jeduthun, plural royal prophets, rulers and gatekeepers at each gate, and uninterrupted service because Levites supplied them. Do not reduce prophets to a singular title for Jeduthun alone.
column3: The scope of the nominative prophets/rulers phrase and inherited English name equivalents remain open.

column2: Retain all ministry set right and prepared that day for Passover and burnt offerings under Josiah's command. The paired ordering/preparation actions remain.
Retain Israelites present, Passover at that time and seven days of Unleavened Bread. No additional seven-day extension is imported from Hezekiah's festival.
Retain no comparable Passover since Samuel, no Israelite king's equivalent and all named participating groups. The final to the Lord continues into the regnal date in verse 19.
Retain year eighteen as the completion of verse 18's festival statement. The four lettered units following are independent stored readings and are preserved in sequence.
Retain burning of mediums, spirit-knowers, tharaphin, idols and karasim in Judah/Jerusalem, to establish the found law book's words. Do not soften burning or silently omit the untranslated terms.
column3: The two transliterated cult terms and the distinction between mediums and spirit-knowers require specialist resolution.

column2: Retain unparalleled turning before and after Josiah, whole heart/soul/strength and all Moses' law. Do not insert a separate king noun where the selected comparison leaves the person implicit.
Retain nevertheless, the Lord's unturned great wrath and Manasseh's provocations. The favorable evaluation of Josiah does not cancel this explicit qualification.

Retain future removal of Judah like Israel and past rejection of Jerusalem and the house, with the nested name promise. Do not regularize the past rejection to a future merely to match the first verb.
Retain Pharaoh Neco's expedition against the Assyrian king at the Euphrates and Josiah meeting him. No Carchemish place name or assertion of alliance is imported.

Retain the relational challenge, denial of war against Judah today, God's command to hurry and warning about God with Neco. This is reported speech, with its status further addressed in the next verse.

Retain Josiah refusing to turn, strengthening to fight, not hearing Neco's words through God's mouth and battle on Magedon's plain. Do not replace strengthening with disguising or erase the divine source attribution.
Retain archers shooting at Josiah and his request for removal because of severe pain. The pain statement is not replaced with a more specific wound diagnosis.
Retain removal from the chariot, transfer to his second chariot, Jerusalem, death/burial and Judah/Jerusalem mourning. The order is not changed to death before transport.

Restore the explicit behold before the record notice. Retain Jeremiah's lament, male and female rulers, to-this-day lament and ordinance for Israel. Rulers is not changed to singers to harmonize another text; the close draft preserves inherited wording.
column3: The pronoun made it and identity of the laments collection remain provisional.

column2: Retain Josiah's deeds and hope written in the Lord's law. Hope is not changed to kindness or pious deeds from another textual tradition.
column3: The relation between the deeds/hope and law record remains syntactically and historically unresolved.

column2: Restore behold in the final record notice while retaining first/last deeds and the Book of the Kings of Israel and Judah. The close draft preserves inherited wording; no access to the named ancient record is implied.
Retain the people's taking, anointing and installing Josiah's son in Jerusalem. The explicit anointing is not omitted.
column3: Jehoahaz here and Joahaz in adjacent units represent the same selected Greek name; final English name consistency remains open.

column2: Retain accession at twenty-three and three months in Jerusalem. The following maternal and judgment additions remain separate stored units.
Retain Amital daughter of Jeremiah from Lobena. Do not equate this Jeremiah with the prophet merely because the English name matches.
Retain evil before the Lord according to all the fathers' conduct. The broad formula is not narrowed to a named ancestor.
Retain Pharaoh Neco binding him at Deblatha in Emath to prevent Jerusalem rule. The location is not silently changed to Riblah.
Retain transport to Egypt and tribute of 100 silver talents and one gold talent. The transport repeats later but is not deleted here.
Retain Eliakim installed in Josiah's place, renaming to Jehoiakim and brother Joahaz taken to Egypt and dying there. The repeated Pharaoh identification remains.

Retain plural giving, taxation beginning, Pharaoh's command and each according to capacity exacting funds from the people. Do not silently replace the selected each-subject phrase with the king alone.
column3: The nominative each and collection agent remain unresolved provisional tax syntax.

column2: Retain accession at twenty-five, eleven years, Zechora daughter of Nerias from Rama and the full evil-conduct evaluation. No different maternal name or town is imported.
Retain Nebuchadnezzar's arrival, three years' service and revolt. The serving king is contextually Jehoiakim rather than the immediately named Nebuchadnezzar.
Retain Chaldeans, Syrian/Moabite raiders, sons of Ammon and Samaria, followed by their departure and the prophetic-word explanation. Samaria is not omitted to match Kings.
column3: Withdrew represents the departure verb provisionally; who departed and whether revolt is intended remain open.

column2: Retain divine anger against collective Judah, removal from His presence and Manasseh's sins. Him for Judah is collective singular, not a newly introduced person.

Retain innocent blood explicitly shed by Jehoiakim, Jerusalem filled and the Lord not wishing to destroy them. Do not change the king to Manasseh or destroy to forgive to harmonize a familiar parallel.
Retain Nebuchadnezzar's attack, bronze fetters and actual removal to Babylon. The selected completed transport is not softened into mere intention to transport.
Retain part of the temple vessels, Babylon repeated and placement in his temple. The possessor is contextually the Babylonian king; no named deity is supplied.
Retain the royal record question, Jehoiakim's sleep, burial in Ganoza with fathers and Jechonias's succession. Do not remove the burial notice to reconcile other accounts.
column3: Ganoza and the unusually full record title remain provisional name/lexical questions.

column2: Retain Jechonias's accession at eighteen, three months and ten days, and evil before the Lord. Do not substitute eight years from another form.
Retain the turn of the year, removal with desirable temple vessels and Zedekiah as his father's brother. The explicit uncle relationship is not reduced to brother.
Retain Zedekiah at twenty-one and eleven years in Jerusalem. No additional mother or accession detail is imported.
Retain evil before his God, no shame before Jeremiah and the Lord's mouth phrase continuing into verse 13. At what came supplies the connective sense of the compressed source.
column3: The coordination of Jeremiah and from the Lord's mouth remains a provisional reconstruction of the English linkage.

column2: Retain broken obligations to Nebuchadnezzar, oath by God, hardened neck and strengthened heart against return. Do not replace the two bodily images with a single generic rebellion statement.
column3: The relationship to the preceding from-the-mouth phrase and the oath's implicit subject require fuller syntax review.

column2: Retain Judah's distinguished men, priests and land's people, multiplied breaches in national abominations and defiled Jerusalem temple. No extra sanctified-in-Jerusalem clause is inserted.
Retain the fathers' God sending through prophets, rising early and sending messengers because He spared people and sanctuary. The repeated sending and anthropomorphic early rising remain.
Retain persistent sneering, contempt for words, mockery of prophets and anger rising until no healing. The three hostile responses and repeated until remain.

Retain the Chaldean king, young men killed in the sanctuary house, explicit Zedekiah not spared, virgins without mercy, elders deported and final delivery of everything. Preserve the singular-to-plural shifts rather than replacing them with a uniform subject.
column3: The sanctuary possessive and final giver are unresolved. Inherited lowercase his must not be treated as proof of a Chaldean sanctuary; the Jerusalem setting supports a divine referent, pending review.

column2: Retain all vessels great and small, treasures, royal/magnate treasures and all brought to Babylon. The repeated totality and treasure terms are not compressed away.
Retain the Lord's house burned, Jerusalem wall demolished, citadels burned and beautiful articles destroyed. Consigning supplies the implied action of the final verbless phrase.
Retain survivors deported, slavery to the ruler and his sons and the kingdom of the Medes as endpoint. Do not substitute Persians merely because Cyrus appears next.
Retain fulfillment through Jeremiah, land receiving its Sabbaths, repeated Sabbath-rest wording and completion of seventy years. No historical start/end dates are invented.

Retain Cyrus's first year as Persian king, after fulfillment of the word, the Lord stirring his spirit and written kingdom-wide proclamation. After is not changed to a purpose clause merely to match another text.

Retain Cyrus's title, all earth's kingdoms from heaven's God, command to build in Jerusalem/Judea, question about His people, future divine presence and imperative ascent. The final presence is shall be, not an unmarked wish.
